verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine with desktop and mobile apps, so data portability is a fair question for it. The evidence covers only model downloads, an OpenAI-compatible serving API and adapter file handling. None of it documents a way to export a user's data, such as chat history or settings, in open formats, so those items are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
